card.alt: Earth Weather on the globe. The picture: the whole planet centred near 30.0°N, 30.0°W, showing Temperature, Wind, Clouds and Borders. Caveats: The satellite cloud image was 3h 10m older than the moment shown. A weather model's value per 1° cell, not a station reading. Wind streaks are sped up; their direction is the model's. Satellite clouds to 80°; the model's nearer the poles. Unsigned capture: one browser's view at one moment. Made by Starcom, <captured>.

caveats: Clouds from EUMETSAT's Geostationary Ring infrared, with GFS cloud cover at the poles was last updated 3h 10m before the moment shown.
Temperature is a weather model's value for each 1° cell, about 110 km across, at the hour stated. It is not a station's reading.
The wind streaks' pace is sped up for viewing; their direction and relative speed are the model's.
Clouds are as geostationary satellites saw them in infrared, at the hour stated, to 80° of latitude; nearer the poles they are the GFS model's.
Unsigned client-side capture: one browser's view at one moment, not an attested record.
